title: Open extension by zero and its counit for topological abelian sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U$ an open subset, and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $U$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Regard its underlying presheaf as a presheaf on the slice category of opens of $X$ over $U$, by evaluating an inclusion $V\to U$ on the inverse image of $V$ in $U$. Define $j_{p!}G$ using the direct-sum construction [def-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf]: its value on $V$ is the direct sum over inclusions $V\to U$. Thus it is $G(V)$ when $V\subseteq U$ and zero otherwise, with the induced restrictions and componentwise action on sheaf morphisms. Define $j_!G$ by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$, define $F|_U$ by evaluating on the images in $X$ of opens of $U$, with the same restrictions. The presheaf counit $j_{p!}(F|_U)\to F$ is the identity on the sole summand for $V\subseteq U$ and zero otherwise; its unique factorization through sheafification is the sheaf counit $j_!(F|_U)\to F$.
